title: Bilocal flows and universality with field-dependent regulators
summary: Many functional renormalization group flows employ a regulator that depends on the fields, as in proper-time and spectrally adjusted flows and in background-independent formulations of gauge theories and quantum gravity. Such a regulator generates additional terms in the flow, and their omission may spoil universality. We introduce bilocal flows, in which the effective action depends on the field and on the cutoff kernel as independent variables.
